en: A colorized postcard view of a historic European town labeled "Bautzen." In the foreground a large multi‑arched stone bridge crosses a river in a green valley. Residential houses with red-tiled roofs and gardens appear on the left, while the middle ground shows medieval towers and fortifications leading up to a dense old town on a hill. Several church spires and a tall towered building dominate the skyline under a lightly clouded sky.
